children: Angi is parting ways with Jeff Kip, who had been chief executive of the home-services marketplace since April 2024, and former Tegna executive Michael Steib has replaced him as CEO.

Angi late Tuesday said Steib, who joined the Denver company's board last month, will remain a director, while Joey Levin, who ceded the CEO post to Kip in 2024, will transition from his role as executive chairman to chairman.

Steib, 50 years old, served as president and CEO of media and technology company Tegna, which was recently acquired by Nexstar Media Group, from August 2024 until May of this year and also spent time at the helm of online art marketplace Artsy and XO Group, the parent of wedding-planning platform The Knot.
Angi said Kip will receive severance benefits related to a termination without cause, adding that he will provide consulting services for six months to assist with the transition.

title: Angi Names Michael Steib CEO, Replacing Jeff Kip
